title: Testing the resource-search-field-values semgrep rule
answers: How do I update the ResourceSearchRequest FIELD_VALUES semgrep rule?
How are semgrep rules tested in this repo?
Where are the test fixtures for the resource-search-field-values check?
body: The rule pkg/storage/unified/semgrep/resource-search-field-values.yaml is validated with `semgrep test --strict --config pkg/storage/unified/semgrep/resource-search-field-values.go` (this step also runs in CI before the real scan). The .go fixture file has `//go:build ignore` and uses `// ruleid: <id>` comments above lines that must match and `// ok: <id>` above lines that must not match. When changing the rule's matched patterns (e.g. to also catch grouped `var (...)` declarations), add/update corresponding ruleid/ok cases in this fixture file so `semgrep test` enforces the new behavior.
applies: Changes to pkg/storage/unified/semgrep/*.yaml rule files and their matching *.go test fixtures.

search: Validating semgrep rule changes in pkg/storage/unified/semgrep/*.yaml requires running `semgrep test --strict --config` against the corresponding .go fixture file, which also runs in CI pre-scan. The fixture file uses //go:build ignore with // ruleid: <id> comments above lines that must match and // ok: <id> comments above lines that must not match. When modifying matched patterns (e.g., grouped var(...) declarations), add or update corresponding ruleid/ok test cases in the fixture so semgrep test enforces the new behavior. Key files: pkg/storage/unified/semgrep/resource-search-field-values.yaml, pkg/storage/unified/semgrep/resource-search-field-values.go.
